live_comparison.interpretation: Paired timing ranges overlap. Do not promote a performance improvement or treat profile samples as normalized transactions. The fixture was retained, not reset; concurrent scheduling and host background work remain variation sources.

machine_code.scope: Static caller sites, not dynamic executed copy counts; unrelated string/payload copies remain.

profiles.interpretation: Copies decrease, but total setup remains material. Go reset reuses eligible context storage; Rust still allocates state and performs variable lookups. Retained Go profiles are diagnostic call-chain comparisons, not matched-work speed ratios.
